commits.message:
feat: implement extend_ttl_in_loop lint (#109)

Detects extend_ttl calls on instance, persistent, or temporary storage
issued directly inside a loop body. Each call is a metered host call
that also pays ledger rent, so refreshing entries one at a time in a
loop multiplies both costs by the iteration count; the diagnostic
suggests batching the extension instead.

Registered under the new EntryLifecycle category. Does not overlap
with soroban_storage_in_loop: that lint's direct in-loop check only
treats get/has/set as a storage access, so extend_ttl never reaches
it.

fix: suppress loop_invariant_storage_access noise in extend_ttl_in_loop fixture

loop_invariant_storage_access (merged into main after this branch diverged)
also matches loop-invariant extend_ttl calls, since it isn't restricted to
get/has/set. Both lints firing on the same call is expected — they recommend
different fixes (hoist vs. batch) — but the fixture suppresses it so the
.stderr stays focused on extend_ttl_in_loop's own diagnostic.
